speaker: Narrator
text: NEPA has taken the light again. All of Lagos is dark.

speaker: Narrator
text: A message must reach the radio tower in the old city before dawn.

speaker: Narrator
text: Pull the trigger to send a sonar ping. Then walk toward the relay tone.

speaker: Narrator
text: Tip: ping often. Every echo shows you where the walls and stalls are.

speaker: Radio
text: You found the relay. Ping, or stand still for a moment, to switch it on.

speaker: Radio
text: First relay is on. The next tone is deeper in the city.

speaker: Radio
text: Second relay is on. Listen north for the last one.

speaker: Radio
text: Third relay is on. The tower signal is live. Follow the beeps.

speaker: Radio
text: This is the tower. Ping, or stand still, to send your message.

speaker: You
text: Mama, it is me. I am safe. Tell everyone the lights are coming back.

speaker: Radio
text: Message sent. Look around you. The city is waking up.

speaker: Vendor
text: Pure water, cold water! Come and get it!

speaker: Sound
text: [A danfo horn sounds in the distance]

speaker: Vendor
text: Fresh bread, fresh bread! Come and get it!

speaker: Radio
text: ...the power is expected back before dawn.
